_comment: Read by Deploy-Image.ps1 inside WinPE. Leave share.path empty for USB-only use. Everything else about a deployment is in AnswerFiles\*.xml.

reporting._comment: Optional. Where PCs report progress for the console's Dashboard. Empty = <content root>\Status. Set a UNC path (e.g. \\deploy-server\Deploy\Status) so USB deployments report to a server too.
